text:
Silver Price in 2019
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2019, the LBMA silver price rose 12.3% between 2019-01-31 ($16.08) and 2019-12-31 ($18.05). The highest sampled price was $18.39 in August and the lowest was $14.48 in May. The mean of these observations was $16.40. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
